# KataGo Remote One-Click v0.1.2

Fixes live analysis from LizzieYzy Next, which was rejected after a successful WebSocket connection.

## Fix

LizzieYzy Next sends `maxVisits: 10000000` for live analysis. v0.1.1 treated any value above the server's 1,000,000 ceiling as a protocol error, so the connection succeeded but `kata-analyze` failed with:

```text
[remote-ws] 自建算力错误：maxVisits must be between 1 and 1000000
```

From v0.1.2:

- `maxVisits` above the configured ceiling is clamped to the ceiling instead of rejected. The default ceiling is now 10,000,000, which matches LizzieYzy Next, so its requests pass through unchanged.
- `maxVisits: 0` (used by some clients to mean "no explicit limit") is omitted before the request reaches KataGo.
- Non-numeric `maxVisits` values are still rejected as protocol errors.

KaTrain and other Analysis Engine clients are unaffected.

## Upgrade

```bash
curl -fsSLo /tmp/katago-remote-install.sh \
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ykrsama/katago-remote-one-click/v0.1.2/install.sh
bash /tmp/katago-remote-install.sh
```

Existing KataGo, model, analysis config, and fixed-hostname settings are reused. After upgrading, reconnect the client and keep using the same private link.

Existing `config.json` files keep the `maxVisits` value written by the old installer (`1000000`). LizzieYzy Next works either way; run the command below if you also want the new 10,000,000 ceiling:

```bash
katago-remote init --max-visits 10000000
katago-remote restart
```
